g.desc: ILIM_AVG = 6.7 A min. 20 W needs 7.25 A at a 3.0 V cell -
renegotiate PDO to 15 W below ~3.4 V.
BQ has an intrensic buck-boost charger so we can use it for discharge PDO regulator
but we must use only 1 USBC port
SMALL CAP CLOSER TO PIN FOR LOW INDUCTANCE, FAST RESPONSE
500 kHz -> tOFF = 2000ns*0.33 = 667 ns (tOFF_min = 145 ns), leaves big margin
Lower fsw also cuts switching loss at 7 A input.
